title: Add Export Schema Test to Build
description: The `npx nx build semio/graphql` command runs `cargo test export_semio_graphql_schema_file -- --ignored --nocapture` to write the GraphQL SDL to `semio/graphql/schema.graphql`. This test exists in `lib.old.rs` but was not ported to the current `lib.rs`, so the build produces 0 tests and the schema file is never updated. Add the `export_semio_graphql_schema_file` ignored test to the `tests` module in `semio/rs/lib.rs`, using `block_on(crate::gql::sdl())` to generate the SDL.
